name: 28079 · Indian Trail, NC
findings: ZIP 28079 (Indian Trail) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28079 (Indian Trail) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28079 (Indian Trail) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
